Your questions

Questions are for this visit only. Each page load starts empty. Export a copy if you want to reuse them.

From AI to your game in three steps

  1. Ask the AI. Enter any subject or lesson, choose how many questions you want, and click Copy AI prompt. If you leave the subject blank, fill in the subject placeholder after pasting the prompt into your AI. Paste that prompt into ChatGPT or another AI. Check its questions and answers for accuracy.
  2. Copy its answer. Copy the entire JSON question list the AI gives you. Paste it into Paste the AI response below. JSON is just a format the game can read; you do not need to write it yourself.
  3. Import. Choose Import & replace to use only the pasted list, or Add to existing to keep your current questions too. Replacing existing questions asks for confirmation. An error leaves your current list unchanged.

Have a question file? Open Import a JSON file, select it, then click Import & replace or Add to existing. Selecting a file only prepares it; it does not import yet.

To write your own questions, open Review or write questions, click Add Question, fill in four different answers, select the correct letter, and click Apply Changes. Export downloads a reusable file; refreshing the page clears the current list.
